=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py:338-349, 621-649 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The root merge-status guard does not recognize Bash append assignments such as `COUNT+=1` as assignment prefixes, so it can skip inspection of a following `git push`.
  WHY: Such a push can bypass the merged-PR guard, and the root hook differs from the template, failing parity tests.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:21526-21598 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: The review-blocked judge stores `GH_TOKEN` in the worktree's Git remote URL and its push sites rely on that persisted credential instead of one-shot credential helpers.
  WHY: Processes with access to the worktree can read the token in plaintext from Git configuration.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:54-65 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  PROBLEM: `ORCH_SCRIPTS_ROOT` is resolved from the caller's working directory rather than the script directory.
  WHY: Severity disagreement: two reviewers rated this BLOCKER and one MAJOR; using the highest, invoking or sourcing the poller outside the repository root can make the isolated judge helper paths nonexistent and prevent judge launches.
- tests/test_plan_codex_step_extraction.py:382 | severity=critical | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: `test_codex_engine_runs_the_unchanged_codex_call` still expects the prior direct Codex invocation after the runner was changed to use the isolated helper.
  WHY: The assertion fails against the current runner, leaving `tests-promote-stall-and-review` and the aggregate `lint` check failing.
- tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py:199 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [google_gemini-3_8-flash, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: `test_poller_file_editing_judges_use_worktrees_and_trusted_push` still asserts the old `push origin` syntax rather than the one-shot credential-helper push syntax.
  WHY: The assertion no longer matches the production push command and causes the contract test to fail.
- tests/test_codex_agent_isolation_contract.py:193-202 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The contract assertions describe poller behavior that the production code does not deliver.
  WHY: The assertions for script-relative helper paths and absence of a tokenized remote URL fail against the cited runtime code, while the advertised isolation posture is not present.

=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

  PROBLEM: The root merge-status guard uses the old assignment regex and misses Bash append assignments such as `COUNT+=1 git push`.
  WHY: The guard skips the prefixed push without inspecting it, and `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:998` reports parity failures.
- TASK_GAP
  Requirement: The CI `lint` aggregate check must pass.
  Expected change site: .claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py (lines 339, 621); tests/test_plan_codex_step_extraction.py (the `test_codex_engine_runs_the_unchanged_codex_call` function, or the code it asserts against in scripts/run_plan_codex.sh)
  Evidence of absence: The root merge-status guard was never updated in this PR (it is absent from pr_changed_files.txt). The template guard (`workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/pr_merge_status_guard.py`) received the `\+?=` fix in an earlier autofix round, but the root copy did not, so the byte-identical parity test `test_template_copies_are_identical` at `tests/test_pr_merge_status_guard.py:998` fails with 5 failures total. The CI `lint` aggregate check (which gates on every job) reports `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator: failure` and `tests-promote-stall-and-review: failure`. The second job failed on `tests/test_plan_codex_step_extraction.py` with an AssertionError at line 382 in `test_codex_engine_runs_the_unchanged_codex_call` (which asserts the old bare-`codex` invocation against `scripts/run_plan_codex.sh:281`, which now uses the isolated-helper wrapper). Neither diffs in the last round nor the full PR diff address either failure.
  SEVERITY: BLOCKER
  ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 5
